assets.description: Official Finch iPhone store screen for Goal Buddies. A gray finch and a smaller pink finch occupy the upper-middle of the in-app card, walking side by side, smiling and raising adjacent wings as if high-fiving. Below them, the Goal Buddies label and two circular bird portraits identify the pair. A white three-row task panel fills the lower third; each goal has an icon, text label, drag handle, and two color-coded completion circles aligned under the two portraits. The mascots visualize shared participation while task controls remain explicit and separate.

Official Finch iPhone store screen for sending support. A gray finch stands centered in the upper half of a pink heart-patterned panel, eyes closed and smiling while hugging an oversized red heart against its torso. Recipient identity and a supportive message sit above the character. Six labeled circular action choices form a two-row grid below, with Valentines selected, followed by a full-width Send a Valentine button. The mascot supplies emotional preview and pose feedback, while the action selection and submission controls remain conventional buttons.

Official Study Bunny iPhone store screen showing the main room. The gray bunny is large, stationary and centered in the lower-middle, seated on a patterned cushion in front of a waterfall scene. A coin balance occupies the top-left. A persistent vertical tool rail on the right contains menu, book, statistics, shop, music, checklist/cards, gift and settings icons. Decorative study objects line the bottom. The pet dominates the scene as an ambient companion without serving as an unlabeled navigation control.

Official Study Bunny timer setup screen. The furnished room is darkened behind the active controls, and a tiny rabbit figure is visible on the timer slider thumb. Countdown mode and a large 35 mins readout occupy the upper half. A light-blue Color Tag sheet overlays the lower half with a close button, a 3-by-5 color grid and an optional subject text field. The mascot is reduced to a small positional indicator during the functional task, so timer and categorization inputs remain visually primary.

Official Pokémon Sleep screen during an active sleep session. The current time and TRACKING SLEEP status are centered at the top on a blue background. A sleeping Pikachu is curled in profile at the exact visual center inside a large circular Poké Ball-like platform, eyes closed with its head resting on its forelegs and tail extending forward. Alarm time appears as a labeled rectangular control below, with relaxing-sound controls continuing lower on the screen. The resting mascot provides an immediate, glanceable confirmation of the app state without replacing the textual status.

Official Pokémon Sleep morning research scene. A huge sleeping Snorlax fills the central two-thirds of the field, mouth open and limbs relaxed. Pikachu sleeps on Snorlax's belly; Charmander lies above-right, Rattata below-left and Meowth below-right. White callout bubbles label the observed poses as Atop-Belly Sleep, Crackling Sleep, Face-Scratching Sleep and Curled-Up Sleep, with stars showing rarity. Date and resource counters remain at the top. Character placement itself becomes the results visualization, turning multiple sleep-style records into a spatial scene around the anchor mascot.

Official Khan Academy Kids store composite centered on real in-app library and exercise UI. The largest tilted tablet panel shows the Library: circular category icons run horizontally near the top, each pairing a pictogram or character face with a text label, and book thumbnails appear in a grid below. Smaller cards above show a fox word-building exercise and a counting activity; Kodi appears as a small guide at the right edge of those exercises, while Kodi is also partially visible beside a large green check button in the left panel. The mascots sit at content edges and reinforce domain/context while the library navigation remains icon-plus-label based.

Official Khan Academy Kids reading composite. A large tilted story page in the upper-right contains illustrated children and readable story text, with a circular back control at its lower-left corner. A second cropped activity panel at lower-left shows Kodi standing at the lower-right edge as an on-screen guide. Large a, b and c letter bubbles float around the activity panels. Reya, the pink red-panda character, strides across the bottom carrying a stack of books with an open-mouth smile, visually assigning the character to reading and phonics while leaving the actual story UI unobstructed.

Official Habitica mobile task-list screen presented in a tilted phone. The user's pixel-art avatar is a compact square portrait at the upper-left of the app header, directly beside Level 53 and Rogue labels. Health, Experience and Mana bars span the header to the right, with currency/resource counts beneath. Full-width color-coded daily task rows occupy most of the screen, each with a large square completion target on the left. The character functions as persistent identity and status in the header while task execution remains a dense conventional list.

Official Habitica Pets & Mounts collection screen. A white mobile panel fills most of the image, with a back arrow, page title, overflow menu and 65 / 480 progress count in the header. A four-column grid names individual pixel pets; owned pets appear in color while missing entries are light-gray silhouettes, making collection state legible beyond text alone. Oversized icy-blue and orange pet sprites frame the bottom corners as decorative reward art without covering the upper collection controls.
